title: Setup SMS Verification in Forms and Surveys
html:
SMS verification in Forms and Surveys helps you confirm that a respondent has access to the phone number they provide. When enabled, KenjiAI sends a one-time password (OTP) to the entered number before the respondent completes verification. This article explains how SMS verification works and how to enable it for a Phone field in a Form or Survey.


TABLE OF CONTENTS

  • What is SMS Verification in Forms and Surveys?
  • How to Set Up SMS Verification in Forms and Surveys
  • Frequently Asked Questions
  • Related Articles

What is SMS Verification in Forms and Surveys?


SMS Verification adds an extra verification step to the Phone field in a KenjiAI Form or Survey. It helps confirm that the person completing the Form or Survey can receive messages at the phone number they entered, which can improve the reliability of the contact information you collect.


When SMS verification is enabled, the respondent enters their phone number and selects Verify Phone. KenjiAI sends an OTP to that number, and the respondent enters the code to complete verification.


The verification status can also be reviewed in the Form or Survey submission data using the Phone Verified field.


Note: SMS OTP messages are subject to applicable messaging charges.

How to Set Up SMS Verification in Forms and Surveys


Enabling SMS verification directly on the Phone field ensures respondents can verify their number before submitting their information. 


Note: To enable SMS OTP Verification, please ensure your phone number is setup in your location settings.


  1. Go to Sites in the left navigation menu.

  2. Select Forms or Surveys.

  3. Create a new Form or Survey, or open an existing one in the builder.



  4. Add a Phone field to the Form or Survey if one has not already been added.

  5. Select the Phone field to open its field settings.

  6. Scroll through the Phone field settings and enable Validate Phone.


  7. Preview, Save and integrate the Form or Survey.

Frequently Asked Questions


Q: Do I need a location phone number before enabling SMS verification?
Yes. A phone number should be configured for the sub-account before enabling SMS OTP verification.


Q: Where can I see whether a respondent verified their phone number?
The verification result is available in the Form or Survey submission data under the Phone Verified field.


Q: Are SMS verification messages free?
No. OTP messages are subject to applicable SMS messaging charges.


Q: What happens if the respondent does not complete phone verification?
Their phone number will not be marked as verified in the submission data.
